recentItems.title: INSOMNIUM - Arch Of The Sky (OFFICIAL VIDEO)
recentItems.description:
INSOMNIUM – Arch of the Sky (OFFICIAL VIDEO)  

New single “Arch of the Sky” by INSOMNIUM, out now via Century Media Records. Taken from the upcoming album “Netherworlds” out October 16th, 2026. Pre-Order now: https://insomnium.lnk.to/NetherworldsID


Video directed and produced by Patric Ullaeus rEvolver Film Company AB 
Music: Ville Friman 
Lyrics: Niilo Sevänen, Ville Friman 
Produced by Miiro Varjus and INSOMNIUM 
Recorded and engineered by Miiro Varjus @ Sonic Pump Studios, Helsinki 
Mixed by Jens Bogren @ Fascination Street Studios, Örebro 
Mastered by Tony Lindgren @ Fascination Street Studios, Örebro 
Keyboards arranged and performed by Aleksi Munter @ San Francisco, CA 
Additional editing by Rosku Lohiniva 
Drum recording assistant Otto Uusitalo 
Guitar technician Janne “Mehtis” Metsola  

Lyrics: 
The burning stars 
Light up the sky 
As chariot rides 
Across the heaven’s vault 
The hunt is on 
The chase to end it all 
Celestial ruin 
Of formless and divine 

Sing with the wind 
Speak to the stones 
Appease the spirits 
Soothe the weary souls 
Prepare the offering 
Rebuild the faith 
Conjure of sacrifice 
Veneration of the dead  

I bow to unseen 
I hear the spirits of the night 
I will never walk alone 
I dream with unseen 
I speak in tongues of twilight 
I will never die alone 

In liminal spaces 
In a speck of dust 
In fleeting moments 
In settling of the dusk 
We blaze our trails 
We forge our paths 
Prepare for the future 
And reconcile with the past 

And every day 
And every night 
We pray to fates 
We fear the call 
And every day 
And every night 
Fear and revere 
The Arch of the sky
